svg.title: Reports & exports
svg.desc: Report status table, PDF/CSV exports and privacy note.

text.tspan: Review status, share reports and export anonymised data.
A ready-to-share report with scores and recommendations.
One row per participant, anonymised identifiers.
Filter by date, assessment or cohort, then download.
Exports exclude direct identifiers by default. Research exports are aggregates only and cannot be re-identified.
